title: Choice Hotels International Launches Access by Choice Privileges®, Allowing Members to Earn and Redeem Points on Concerts, Sports, and Live Events
body_markdown:
*New* *offering* *expands Choice Privileges rewards beyond hotel stays, making memorable experiences more attainable with flexible options to pay for tickets using cash, points, or both*


**Key Highlights:**


- **Unlocking more ways to experience live events:** Access by Choice Privileges® gives members access to thousands of concerts, sporting events, theater performances, and other live entertainment.
- **More ways to earn and redeem:** Members earn three Choice Privileges points per eligible dollar spent on ticket purchases, with redemptions starting at just 2,000 points.*
- **Flexible ways to pay:** Members can purchase eligible tickets using cash, Choice Privileges points or a combination of both.
- **Limited-time bonus:** Eligible U.S. members can earn a one-time 1,000-point bonus on their first qualifying ticket transaction through April 30, 2027.**


NORTH BETHESDA, Md.


, Nov. 17, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH) today announces the launch of[Access by Choice Privileges](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4824241-1&h=2667020526&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.choicehotels.com%2Faccess&a=Access+by+Choice+Privileges) ®, an expanded experiential platform within its award-winning[Choice Privileges](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4824241-1&h=1455172618&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.choicehotels.com%2Fchoice-privileges&a=Choice+Privileges) loyalty program that brings together exclusive experiences, activities and attractions, and now live event ticketing. Building on Choice Privileges' existing experiential offerings, Access by Choice Privileges now gives members even more ways to use their membership beyond hotel stays, including the ability to earn and redeem points on eligible tickets to thousands of concerts, sporting events, theater performances, and other live entertainment, with flexible options to pay using cash, points or a combination of both.


"At Choice Hotels, we believe loyalty should be rewarding and attainable for all our members, whether they travel frequently or occasionally," said Geeta Chandan, Vice President, Loyalty, Choice Hotels International. "Travelers today are looking for more ways to get value from every trip and make the most of the points they earn. With Access by Choice Privileges, members can turn those points into memorable experiences starting at just 2,000 points, whether that's seeing their favorite artist perform live or cheering on their team. By giving members the flexibility to use cash, points, or a combination of both, we're making more of what they value feel within reach."


**More Ways to Earn and Redeem Choice Privileges Points**


Access by Choice Privileges extends the value of Choice Privileges beyond the hotel stay with Access Tickets, Access Activities, and Access Experiences. Through Access Tickets, members can earn and redeem points on tickets to sporting events, including NBA, NFL, and MLB games, as well as tickets to the NHL Winter Classic, along with concerts, theater, and thousands of other events creating additional value for members who stay at Choice Hotels and earn Choice Privileges points.


Beyond live event tickets, Access Activities allow members to enhance their trips with unique offerings from Get Your Guide, including Grand Ole Opry tours in Nashville or NASA Mission Control tours in Houston. For members looking to go big, Access Experiences offers opportunities to bid on one-of-a-kind experiences, including the Army vs. Navy game day experience and Hall of Fame Tournament, and premium hospitality and sideline passes at college football games across the SEC and Big Ten.


**Expanding the Choice Privileges Experience**


Access by Choice Privileges is the latest way Choice Hotels is making loyalty more accessible and rewarding, giving members more ways to put their points to use through experiences that align with their lifestyles and travel habits.


Through a dedicated, easy-to-navigate platform, members can explore live event tickets alongside a broader suite of Choice Privileges benefits, including opportunities to earn and redeem rewards, bid on exclusive experiences, and access special discounts and offers tied to their travel journeys.


Access by Choice Privileges is offered in partnership with[TFL](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4824241-1&h=2310966878&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftflgroup.com%2Floyalty-programs%2F%3Futm_source%3Dpress_release%26utm_medium%3Dreferral%26utm_campaign%3Dchoice_launch_november2026&a=TFL) , whose ticketing technology and inventory provide members with access to thousands of live events, supported by dependable ticket fulfillment, transparent pricing, and customer support.


"Live events are a natural extension of the travel and loyalty experience, giving members more ways to use the value they've earned for something personally meaningful," said Nathan Williford, SVP, Business Solutions at TFL. "We're proud to help power Access by Choice Privileges with the technology, live-event selection, and white-glove support that allow Choice Hotels to bring those experiences directly to its members, whether they're looking for a local event this weekend or planning a bucket list trip."


**A Limited-Time Bonus for Choice Privileges Members**


To celebrate the launch of Access by Choice Privileges, eligible Choice Privileges members residing in the United States can receive a one-time bonus of 1,000 points when they complete their first qualifying live event ticket purchase or redemption through the program available now through April 30, 2027.


The bonus is available in addition to the regular points earned on eligible ticket purchases.


Members can explore Access by Choice Privileges by visiting choicehotels.com and logging into their loyalty account. Travelers who are not yet Choice Privileges members can enroll for free at choicehotels.com/choice-privileges to begin enjoying the benefits of the program, including opportunities to earn and redeem points on live events through the platform at[ChoiceHotels.com/access](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4824241-1&h=285749741&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.choicehotels.com%2Faccess&a=ChoiceHotels.com%2Faccess) .
